stem: A community pharmacy prepares to close. Select all patient-notice duties supported by 247 CMR 6.13.

choices.text: Identify patients who received prescriptions in the preceding 90 days.
Destroy every patient file on the closure date.
Attempt notice at least 14 days before closure and post conspicuous notice.
Notify only patients with controlled prescriptions.
Refuse all requested transfers during the notice period.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A closing pharmacy identifies patients served in the preceding 90 days, attempts notice at least 14 days before closure, posts conspicuous notice, and supports timely patient-file transfer.

choice_analysis.D: This statement imports Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This statement imports Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
